cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Put on our quiz-team badge before I explain the final round.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? What happens if we lose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We'll face that together. That's what the badge means.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to face anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's start with the very easy agreement to wear blue.

mechanism: A treats its former quiz pupil badge-wearing as a modest familiar exercise that recruits B onto A side before the losing penalty is revealed.
confusable: Not fully informed team recruitment: A repeatedly postpones the stakes while seeking a small visible commitment.
comparison: Wearing a team color versus signing a joint-entry form above a penalty clause.
